DateChoice.name: Date Choice
DateChoice.definition: Details related to the date on which a variation is effective.

DocumentaryEvent.name: Documentary Event
DocumentaryEvent.definition: Details related to the documentary event on which a variation is triggered.

DateChoiceAndDocumentaryEvent1Rule.definition: Either DateChoice or at least one occurrence of DocumentaryEvent must be present. Both may be present.

DateChoiceAndDocumentaryEvent2Rule.definition: Either DateChoice or at least one occurrence of DocumentaryEvent must be present. Both may be present.
